name: Kurasawa Sanae
source:
A gentle and kind girl, she is an idol at school.
She takes up many lessons, such as the tea ceremony and flower arranging.
She does not take part in the bullying of Murakoshi, but that does not mean she likes him.
A typical Japanese girl with long hair (tied up with a ribbon or something).
She has a relatively slim figure and average breast size.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.blackrainbow.jp/br/gakuen/gakuen_chara.html]official site[/url]]
